review_notes: I read the whole file. The declarations are diagBlock, offDiagBlock, their algebraic lemmas, the reflection and commutation characterisations, and the quadratic-form extension lemmas. I searched Mathlib's Analysis directory for pinching, block-diagonal, off-diagonal and reducing-subspace concepts for operators relative to U ⊕ Uᗮ. I found no existing Mathlib definition of this concept. Matrix block constructions in Mathlib are a different representation, and the hits for "reduces" and "offDiag" were unrelated. The only uses of diagBlock and offDiagBlock in the Tau Ceti repo are in this file. The definitions are built from Mathlib's starProjection and reflection, and the file does not reimplement either. I did not search every Mathlib directory exhaustively, for example Mathlib/Algebra or Mathlib/LinearAlgebra, so a competing concept there is not fully excluded. I found no justified finding.
